title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Plan Installments for Completing the Lease Term
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — installments added to a lease-end plan for a completed term**

**Rule.** The completion installments added to a plan are 2 (the full-completion installments) when the number of the lease's monthly payments, less the number of payments on the lease that were returned, is at least the lease term in months plus the maturity extension months used; 1 (the term-completion installment) when that number is at least the lease term in months but below that sum; and none when it is below the lease term in months. The installments are added to the plan's number of installments before the plan balance is divided.

**The count.** Monthly payments posted on the lease are counted; every payment on the lease that was returned is then subtracted.

**Boundaries (hypothetical lease: 36-month term, 2 extension months used)**

| Monthly payments posted | Payments returned | Count | Completion installments |
|---|---|---|---|
| 38 | 0 | 38 | 2 |
| 38 | 1 | 37 | 1 |
| 36 | 0 | 36 | 1 |
| 36 | 1 | 35 | none |

For a 36-month lease with no extension months, a count of 36 meets the full sum and adds 2.
